purpose: S01 forward capability acceptance, not emitter recovery
support_rationale: Eight output codes exceed truncation/one-code verified kernel uncertainty; two footprint-separated blocks prevent a single tiny patch admitting a positive test. These gates apply only to this declared controlled output profile.
tolerance_rationale: One code is the existing controlled direct-kernel float/quantization envelope. No universal physical lux or source-position threshold is inferred. Zero baseline must have nonzero informative support before relative improvement is defined.

profile.selection: training nuisance fit; validation profile comparison; heldout confirmation

profile_rationale: Two codes exceed the sum of two one-code kernel envelopes. A narrower separation retains alternatives, not a forced compiler winner.
failure_policy: No all-black/unavailable/partial result may satisfy required positive capability. Unknown geometry requires a typed unknown result, never a numerical zero. Inadmissible required data fails admission; it is not silently skipped. Historical weak/negative folds remain diagnostic. All contracts are independently reported.
threshold_changes: Change policy version and review rationale; never relax this version after a control fails. Synthetic/source-answer-copy outputs cannot count as emitter recovery.
revision_reason: Add independent-aperture support after v1 doorway admission failure; retain v1 diagnostic. No numerical threshold or split changes.
